name: explanada

scripts.test:firebase: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth,storage --project demo-plaza --config firebase.emulator.json "node --test src/tests/firebase.rules.test.cjs src/tests/functions.integration.test.cjs"
scripts.demo: cross-env VITE_USE_EMULATORS=true firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,storage,functions --project demo-plaza --config firebase.emulator.json --ui "node demo/seed-emulators.mjs && vite"
scripts.electron:dev: concurrently "cross-env BROWSER=none npm run dev" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 && electron . --dev"
scripts.build:pages: cross-env VITE_BASE_PATH=/Explanada/ vite build --mode mock --outDir dist-mock

description: Plataforma de administración para plazas comerciales (white-label): estacionamiento QR, locatarios, eventos, nómina, contabilidad y dashboard con IA.
author: Aloner23
